title: PUT orders/{order_ref}/redemptions request: the full declarative set of holds for an order (empty = release all)
description: Sent with an Idempotency-Key when the shopper places the order, built from the order's Pixalink coupon lines: what WooCommerce actually discounted. discount_cents / discount_tax_cents are the coupon line's discount and its tax share; the value taken off is discount_cents, plus discount_tax_cents when cart.prices_include_tax (in a tax-exclusive store the tax share comes off on top, WooCommerce coupon semantics). points is the points spent: the shopper's choice, or fewer when WooCommerce capped the discount at the subtotal (the fewest points that cover the value), so it need not be a multiple of the quote's step. amount_cents is the credits spent (= the value). coupon_code is lower case (WooCommerce lower-cases coupon codes; match case-insensitively, or by voucher_id). Errors: 409 points_insufficient {available} | credits_insufficient {available_cents} | voucher_unavailable, 422 discount_mismatch (the value exceeds what the redemption is worth), 403 verification_required.
